page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on x86_64 architecture and KVM virtualization. The system is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, delivering 128 dedicated vCPUs. It features 256.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 2.0 GB of RAM allocated per core.

Network performance is supported by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance profile does not include local disk storage or GPU hardware acceleration, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent operational data. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provided with this instance configuration.

The 1:2 CPU-to-memory design offers efficient compute density for parallel computing tasks that do not require high memory-per-core ratios. This instance is configured for compute-intensive enterprise workloads such as software compilation, batch processing, static web serving, ETL tasks, and CI/CD operations.
